overwrite: refuse when output namespace already exists

strategy.definition: unchanged M17.1R Donchian 120/60, long-only, flat/long, seven equal isolated sleeves
strategy.execution: signal at 4h close, fill at next consecutive 4h open, terminal liquidation at final close

policies.C: train-calibrated equal-sleeve buy-and-hold plus cash reserve, no rebalance or transfers

calibration.returns: synchronized UTC-midnight daily net returns after base execution costs
calibration.failure: METHODOLOGY_BLOCKED if buy-and-hold sigma is zero/non-finite or strategy sigma is non-finite
calibration.capital: lambda times initial capital split equally across seven sleeves at first evaluation open; remainder held as cash

costs.accounting: apply to actual traded notional; passive returns are simulated and never mechanically scaled

main.lambda_reuse: one lambda from initial Train is reused unchanged for Validation and reused Test

full_history: descriptive only; continuous strategy path is preserved separately; main Train lambda may be shown with an explicit non-causal/in-sample warning before calibration ends
paired_endpoint: mean of exact-date daily net-return differences, Strategy minus calibrated passive

bootstrap.alignment: exact continuous dates; no dropna; windows never combined

decision.PROMISING_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE: primary base 28-day CI lower bound > 0; strategy reused-Test net return > 0; at least two of three fold point effects > 0; doubled-cost reused-Test point effect > 0 and strategy return > 0; strategy reused-Test realized daily volatility and absolute max drawdown are each no greater than calibrated passive
decision.WEAK: some positive economic evidence exists but every PROMISING criterion is not met
decision.NO_INCREMENTAL_EVIDENCE: no positive primary, fold, or stress evidence

notes: All evaluation periods are reused research periods and are not untouched holdouts.
No model training, parameter search, threshold tuning, new gate, stop, target, or strategy modification is permitted.
Cash yield is zero and passive sleeves are never rebalanced.
